what: sensitivity of the growth ratio to rsa_ktau_nu (massive/massless neutrino switch)
reading: 30 is already the best of the three; the high-k overshoot (+9%) does not respond to this switch at all. Combined with the earlier scans (rsa_ktau, inv_tau form, lmax, dlna_max, freeze depth, m_nu) the high-k error has no knob left in the neutrino or truncation sector.
